    About

    Cutting It Close is a free game made by Gareth, who you might just find behind the chair at Noggins Organic Salon. It is just for fun: real color, bleach and cutting shears belong in a professional’s hands, so please don’t try these at home!

    Featuring the Noggins stylists Kez, Tamarah, Amy, Josie, Gareth, Jess, Lily and Jade.
